EVERYDAY ECO GIFT BOX – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | D1000

The EVERYDAY ECO GIFT BOX – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set is designed for companies and individuals looking for thoughtful, premium and sustainable gifting options. This beautifully curated gift box brings together planet-friendly products made from natural, biodegradable and reusable materials. Whether you are planning corporate gifts, employee welcome kits, festival gifting, or eco-conscious hampers for events, this gift set offers the perfect balance of utility, design and sustainability.

Packed elegantly in an 8″x8″x3″ rigid box, the EVERYDAY ECO GIFT BOX is more than a gift — it’s a statement of environmental responsibility. The combination of plantable stationery, cork accessories, bamboo bottle and organic honey makes this gift hamper a unique and meaningful choice. Each item encourages greener habits and supports a zero-waste lifestyle.

What Makes This Eco-Friendly Gift Set Special?

In today’s world, sustainable gifting is the new trend, and the EVERYDAY ECO GIFT BOX – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | D1000 stands out for its premium quality and thoughtful product selection. Each item in this curated collection is crafted with eco-conscious materials — plantable paper, cork, bamboo, beeswax and natural ingredients. This makes it a high-value choice for green corporate gifts and environment-friendly giveaways.

Key Highlights of the EVERYDAY ECO GIFT BOX

  • Plantable Pen & Pencil Set (4+4) – Eco-friendly writing tools embedded with seeds that can be planted after use.
  • Pure Honey (2 Flavours) – Natural, preservative-free honey in two delightful variants.
  • Beeswax Candle – A clean-burning candle made from pure beeswax for a soothing ambience.
  • Cork Sticky Notes – Sustainable, reusable and stylish sticky notes made from natural cork.
  • Bamboo Bottle (450ml) – A durable and eco-friendly bamboo water bottle, perfect for daily hydration.
  • Cork Coaster Set (4) with Holder – Biodegradable coasters paired with a cork holder for elegant desk organization.
  • Plantable Notepad B6 (40 pages) – A seed-embedded notebook that grows into plants once discarded.
  • Premium Rigid Box (8”x8”x3”) – Strong, elegant and ideal for premium corporate gifting.

Why Choose the EVERYDAY ECO GIFT BOX for Corporate Gifting?

Companies seeking meaningful and sustainable gifting options prefer the EVERYDAY ECO GIFT BOX – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | D1000 for its professional presentation and eco-conscious selection. It supports CSR initiatives, enhances brand value and aligns with environmentally responsible corporate culture.

This gift set is ideal for:

  • Employee onboarding and welcome kits
  • Corporate events and conferences
  • Client appreciation gifts
  • Festive gifting and seasonal hampers
  • Sustainable giveaways for workshops, seminars and green campaigns

Benefits of Choosing Eco-Friendly Corporate Gifts

By choosing this eco-friendly gift set, you contribute to reducing plastic waste, supporting natural materials and promoting mindful gifting. Items like plantable stationery and cork products help inspire sustainable habits in daily life. The bamboo bottle and plantable notepad offer long-term usability, making the gift box practical and memorable.

The EVERYDAY ECO GIFT BOX – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | D1000 is crafted for those who value sustainability and premium quality. With its thoughtful assortment, it delivers emotional value while supporting environmental well-being — making it one of the most sought-after choices in eco-friendly corporate gifting.
